remarks: Beautiful NYC-style loft condo in the sought-after, renovated hat factory known as Clocktower Close. This stunning, freshly-painted loft features 14' ceilings, two-story windows, exposed original wood beams, and a stunning brick wall that adds warmth and charm. The open kitchen/dining area has been renovated with quartz countertops, a subway tile backsplash, large gray tile floor, a stove/air fryer, and a dishwasher. The new chic, modern half-bath just off the kitchen provides style and convenience on the main level. The upstairs primary bedroom suite is spacious and private and has plenty of closet space and newly installed recessed lighting. Many amenities, including a fitness center with sauna and locker rooms, conference room, community game room/lounge and community kitchen, laundry room and landscaped courtyard. Located just 7-minutes from bustling downtown South Norwalk, restaurants, shops, Norwalk beaches, train, I-95 and the Merritt Parkway.
